findings.description: The old code fetched all keys with a single catalog.get_many(locale, wanted) call. The new loop calls catalog.exists and then catalog.get for every key in every candidate locale, so a page with N keys and a chain of length L makes up to 2*N*L catalog calls. If the catalog is backed by a DB or file, this becomes an N+1 pattern, and exists followed by get is also a check-then-act race if the catalog is reloaded in between.
findings.suggestion: Call catalog.get_many(candidate, remaining_keys) once per locale in the chain, shrinking the set of remaining keys after each call.
findings.title: Per-key catalog lookups replace the batched get_many call

findings.description: Bundle.locale is set to chain[0], which is the normalised tag (for example 'pt_br' becomes 'pt-BR'), rather than the caller's locale. Callers, serialised JSON and missing_report keys that rely on the original string will see a different value. Invalid or empty locales now raise ValueError from normalise, where they previously just yielded all-missing bundles.
findings.suggestion: Keep locale=locale in the Bundle, or normalise consistently and document the change. Compare sources against chain[0] inside fallback_keys.
findings.title: Bundle.locale is now the normalised locale instead of the requested one
